args.message:
Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

src/money.py imported ROUND_HALF_UP but the function contract and
tests/test_money.py expect banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This
caused the nightly test run to fail.

Fix round_money to use ROUND_HALF_EVEN per FIN-212

src/money.py imported ROUND_HALF_UP but the function contract and
tests/test_money.py expect banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN). This
caused the nightly test run to fail.

args.body:
## Problem
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

## Fix
`round_money` now quantizes to cents using `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`, matching the FIN-212 requirement and the test suite:
- `Decimal("2.675")` -> `2.68` (up, since 7 is odd)
- `Decimal("2.665")` -> `2.66` (down, since 6 is even)

## Verification
CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` (sha `08d3cd5986`): **passed**.
args.head: fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
